title: Imported variable used in dynamic property name are not replaced
body:
<!-- Please don't delete this template or we'll close your issue -->
<!-- Before creating an issue please make sure you are using the latest version of webpack. -->
<!-- Also consider trying the webpack@beta version, maybe it's already fixed. -->

**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Report a bug
<!-- Please ask questions on StackOverflow or the webpack Gitter (https://gitter.im/webpack/webpack). -->
<!-- Issues which contain questions or support requests will be closed. -->

**What is the current behavior?**
When importing a variable and using it as a dynamic property name, it is not replaced in the bundle.
> In
```js
import var1 from './export';
const { [var1]: value } = {};

```
> Out 
```js
/* 1 */
/***/ (function(module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {

"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(__webpack_exports__, "__esModule", { value: true });
/* harmony import */ var __WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__export__ = __webpack_require__(0);

const { [var1]: value } = {};


/***/ })
```
**How to reproduce**
See [https://github.com/johangirod/bug_webpack_dynamic_property_name](https://github.com/johangirod/bug_webpack_dynamic_property_name)
**What is the expected behavior?**
Expected to replace the dynamic propery name with the imported variable. Something like : 
> Out 
```js
/* 1 */
/***/ (function(module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {

"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(__webpack_exports__, "__esModule", { value: true });
/* harmony import */ var __WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__export__ = __webpack_require__(0);

const { [__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__export__["a" /* default */]]: value } = {};


/***/ })
```

Webpack 2
Node 7.6.0
OSX
